samples.label: B61. Number of traffic accidents causing injury by region, month, day of week, hour, measure and year
samples.source: Swedish Civil Defence and Resilience Agency
note: Road, terrain, rail, air or water traffic accidents attended by the municipal fire and rescue service, where they assessed that at least one person was injured. Before 2018 there was some under-reporting from a few municipalities, see Quality Declaration for more information (in Swedish). The contents of the incident report have been revised, and some adaptations have been made so that the figures are as comparable as possible, see Quality Declaration for more information (in Swedish). Damage as assessed by fire officer. The classification of injuries was revised in 2018, see Quality Declaration for more information (in Swedish). Several types of vehicle can be involved in one accident and certain vehicle types are not included any specific category, so the sum of the various types of accident may be different to the total number of accidents.
